```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records
```

with your API key (`secret123`) in the `x-apikey` header. The JSON response will include a list of DNS records, each with an `id` field; filter for records where `"type": "CNAME"` to get the relevant IDs.
